Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
In message <3c45f643....@news.videotron.ca>,
ra...@videotron.ca (Remy Auclair) mumbled something about:

>We have a freak who played a Great Beast with Huitzilopochtli when he
>had a Soul Gem on him. He burned Huitzi and then he had a brand new
>(free) Ian Forestal with a Soul Gem on him. What do you think of that
>? And we were lucky he didn't thought about putting some Master
>Necromancy and some Possesion for Ian Forestal to go back for
>Huitzi...

That's pretty neat.

Three turns to transfer out Itchy-Poker.
One turn to equip a Soul Gem.
One turn to play Call the Great Beast.
One turn to actually CALL the Great Beast.

Need both a Soul Gem and Great Beast in hand, which means you better
have a LOT in your deck -- 6 each, minimum. And you better have at
least four SupercalifragilisticHuitzilopochtli-docious in your crypt,
meaning that you have a good chance of vampire #5 being him: splat goes
the combo.

Assuming you've laden up your deck with Necrophilia skill cards, Huitzo
can get a NEC card on turn 4 and call the Great Beast in one turn -- and
pull himself back out if he happens to be the next one up. Downside:
must now transfer out Ian Forestal normally, and the whole Possession
angle has gone flop.

Better angle: use FOR skill cards and 12 Huitzo's. Call the Great
Beast action now becomes unblockable via Daring the Dawn, and anytime
you need a new vampire, just get yourself burned with DtD. Minion Tap
each Huitzo lots, and preferred action (of course) should be
Govern/Condition/DtD. Sucks to be Deflected.

>I'm I dreaming or all this stuff is legal ?

Seems legal from here. Seems more than a little bit fragile, too.

It'd be neat to see it actually go. I lack confidence.

Hmm.. itchy-poker = huitzilipoctli ?

But anyways, I had thought about nice 12 stage combo about huitzi and
the great beast with doing unblockable actions and always minion
tapping both from full blood to one or two to do the actions =).

You remember that if huitzilipoctly has nice special for this :
"During your master phase you may pay a pool to gain a master phase if
Huitzilopochtli is ready."

It's quite cheap.

So the combo went something like this:

(Crypt full of huitzis)

1. Bring Hui out
2. Minion Tap Hui
3. Put Fortitude Master on Hui (use his special)
4. Fetch soul gem - Freak Drive
5. Call the great beast (choose atleast FOR)
Hui burns and another comes up with the soul gem

6&7. Both do whatever with both(too mad great beast isn't a baali,
otherwise he could sanguine instruct Hui), like bleed
Next turn.
8. Minion Tap Beast
9. Put Fortide master on Hui (use his special)
10. (minion tap Hui if you have parthenon etc).
11. Beast bleeds (or rushes etc) unblockable (daring the dawn) with
modifiers etc.
12. Hui gets another beast

So continue from step 5 to the infinity. You could also do something
else with the beast and then start rolling with force of will etc.

It should get you quite a nice pool gain per turn (better if you have
parthenon), do unblockable bleeds and die horribly by clogged minion
taps on hand.

Well you only need these cards per turn for this combo to be
effective:
2x Minion taps
1x Fortiude
1x CtGB
1x Daring
some stealth =)
some bleed modifiers...

- Jukka
